findings.severity: Interoperability boundary (non-blocking for the B5-B minimum claim)
findings.summary: BEGIN/COMMIT/ROLLBACK/ROUTE are refused at the B3-A decode boundary: the accepted B5-A transport closes the connection without the B3-B documented 08N06 FAILURE, so the official driver surfaces ServiceUnavailableException instead of the richer refusal.
findings.classification: Accepted capability limitation / cross-component wiring difference (B5-A decode path vs B3-B ReceiveBytes handling); no production change authorized by B5-B.

findings.summary: Under the accepted generic 50N42 classification, the official driver classifies a refused auto-commit query as an unknown ProtocolException and destroys the connection instead of RESET-recovering it; session-level recovery via a fresh connection works.
